feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Iterations 0 to 3 (entityR2B scores 53.612, 53.3955, 53.3054, 53.2728) all ended off_track in all 240 trials. max_error stayed at 0.060 to 0.067 m, line_loss_events was 1 to 2 per run, and steering_oscillation was 0.07 to 0.16. Pitch from 10 to 20 mm, footprint from 12 to 16 mm, track from 0.12 to 0.10 m, and kp from 1.2 to 1.4 each left max_error at the floor, so coverage and steering gain are not the binding levers. Only mass remains untested alone, which is why this candidate changes it. Read the next race as follows. If line_loss_events falls to 0 and max_error drops below about 0.06 m, the limit is lag, so move the sensor bar forward to y = 0.06 m. If one line loss per run remains with max_error still at the floor, yaw inertia is not enough, so try the minimum mass of 0.4 kg before any other change. If line losses clear but progress stays low, the limit is top speed, so try wheel_radius 0.035 with wheel_track 0.10.

If line losses are cleared but progress stays between 0.10 and 0.20 with off_track endings, try wheel_radius 0.035 with wheel_track 0.10.
